en: An old black-and-white postcard depicting the famous Hall of Mirrors (Galerie des Glaces) inside the Palace of Versailles. The grand, ornately decorated gallery features high arched ceilings with elaborate artwork and large mirrors lining one side, with tall windows on the opposite side. There are chairs and furniture arranged along the walls. At the bottom is a caption in both French and English describing the historical significance of the location.
